description: List the user's subscription charge history (SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGE rows from the keeper cron), newest first. Cursor-paginated — pass `nextCursor` from the previous page back as `cursor` to advance. Each row carries the plan tier, billing period (MONTHLY/ANNUAL), amount (lower-units string), currency, status, on-chain transaction hash, billing period start/end, and the invoice number (null until the user generates the invoice). Use get_subscription_invoice to generate the PDF for a charge.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`.

name: list_subscription_charges
